crew.overview: Near a gray and unnamed city is the Zone, a place guarded by barbed wire and soldiers, and where the normal laws of physics are victim to frequent anomalies. A stalker guides two men into the Zone, specifically to an area in which deep-seated desires are granted.
crew.title: Stalker

details.biography: Evgeny Vasilyevich Tsymbal (Russian: Евгений Васильевич Цымбал; born September 5, 1949; Yeysk) is a Soviet and Russian director of feature and documentary films, historian, screenwriter, and editor. Winner of the National Cinematography Award "Nika" (2002, 2006 and 2015), the British Academy of Film and Television (BAFTA) award. In total, Evgeny Tsymbal's films have received about 50 prizes at domestic and international film festivals.
details.name: Evgeny Tsymbal
